title: What If One Gram of Antimatter Touched Matter?

scenes.text: What if one gram of antimatter touched one gram of matter? The blast is bigger than you'd think.
They would annihilate completely, turning all their mass into pure energy: about 43 kilotons of TNT.
That is roughly three times the Hiroshima bomb, from the mass of two paperclips.
But nobody can make that much. All the antimatter CERN has ever made would power a light bulb for a few minutes.
At about 10 nanograms a year, one gram would take roughly 100 million years to produce.
The most powerful fuel imaginable is also the one we can never stockpile.

description:
What if one gram of antimatter touched matter?
Their mass would turn into about 43 kilotons of energy, but making a gram would take around 100 million years.
